hypothesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive canonical-SMILES prior and frozen sequence representation only on the unlabeled corpus, then restart each objective with an oracle anchor copied from that prior and a probabilistic surrogate fit to every task-local scored molecule. Before each suggestion, clone the current oracle anchor, optimize only that disposable clone against the surrogate posterior mean under prior regularization, ancestrally generate a fresh ephemeral set from the changed token policy, and select the evaluator-announced batch by greedy expected improvement. After oracle feedback, refit the surrogate on all real observations, update the persistent oracle anchor only from returned true rewards, and discard the surrogate-trained clone, so surrogate feedback changes the source distribution before acquisition while every submitted molecule remains de novo.
method_thesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model and its sequence representation only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, retain a frozen prior, and restart all task-local state for each independent objective. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. The optimization target is solely the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus contains enough canonical SMILES syntax and chemical diversity for the compact autoregressive prior to generate valid novel molecules within the preparation and per-task time limits.

Frozen corpus-trained sequence embeddings place structurally and reward-related molecules close enough that a probabilistic surrogate fit from ten initial and subsequent task-local observations has useful local posterior structure and nondegenerate uncertainty.

Returned scores have enough variation for true-reward augmented-likelihood updates to distinguish anchor training weights and for expected improvement to distinguish members of each fresh ephemeral pool.

Bounded prior-regularized surrogate-reward updates can shift token probabilities toward useful regions without collapsing validity or novelty, and the oracle anchor remains a recoverable starting point when a round's surrogate is misleading.
Ancestral sampling from the optimized clone yields enough valid, unseen canonical molecules to form an acquisition pool and fill every evaluator-announced batch before the 3000-proposal safety limit.

Useful high-scoring chemistry is reachable by autoregressive policy shifts supported by the corpus representation; transfer is weaker for discontinuous objectives, disconnected rewarding modes absent from the prior, severely miscalibrated small-data posteriors, or objectives whose best regions require sequences the tokenizer and decoder cannot express.
Each objective is handled by a fresh process with no labeled observations, fitted surrogate, anchor updates, ephemeral candidates, or inner-policy state transferred across tasks.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if the prepared canonical policy cannot generate valid novel molecules, if all real observations are not assimilated into a finite probabilistic posterior, if surrogate-only inner optimization fails to move a disposable clone toward higher posterior-mean reward while leaving the oracle anchor unchanged, if the persistent anchor receives surrogate rather than true-reward updates, or if submitted molecules cannot be traced to fresh ancestral clone samples selected in the logged greedy expected-improvement order.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode as corpus-only training of a compact autoregressive SMILES language model, retaining a frozen prior, vocabulary, canonical-sequence encoder weights, and held-out generation diagnostics as reusable artifacts. In run mode, seed every RNG from init, load the artifacts on logical cuda:0, use exactly one canonical SMILES view per scored molecule, and build a task-local exact probabilistic regressor on frozen pretrained sequence embeddings. Initialize a persistent oracle anchor from the prior and update it after each observe message with score-weighted augmented-likelihood training on only genuinely oracle-scored task-local molecules, regularized to the frozen prior. For every suggest message, make a fresh clone of that anchor, perform bounded oracle-free augmented-likelihood updates whose molecular rewards are the current surrogate posterior means, ancestrally sample complete SMILES only from the resulting clone, canonicalize and remove invalid, previously evaluated, previously emitted, and within-pool duplicate products, and keep the resulting finite pool only for that round. Select exactly the batch size announced in init by sequential greedy expected improvement against the best true score, conditioning each later selection with a posterior-mean fantasy to account for already selected candidates. Retain generation and acquisition provenance for observability, never score or retrieve corpus members as candidates, never use surrogate rewards to update the persistent anchor, and discard both the pool and inner clone after the round.
research_intent.mechanism: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive canonical-SMILES prior and frozen sequence representation only on the unlabeled corpus, then restart each objective with an oracle anchor copied from that prior and a probabilistic surrogate fit to every task-local scored molecule. Before each suggestion, clone the current oracle anchor, optimize only that disposable clone against the surrogate posterior mean under prior regularization, ancestrally generate a fresh ephemeral set from the changed token policy, and select the evaluator-announced batch by greedy expected improvement. After oracle feedback, refit the surrogate on all real observations, update the persistent oracle anchor only from returned true rewards, and discard the surrogate-trained clone, so surrogate feedback changes the source distribution before acquisition while every submitted molecule remains de novo.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: After the ten fixed observations, each objective permits only 290 adaptive oracle calls and therefore only 29 feedback rounds at the frozen batch size. Directly updating a SMILES policy from those sparse batches can overfit noisy winners, while merely ranking samples from an unchanged prior cannot move proposal mass toward promising chemistry. The root must turn every task-local observation, including low scores, into a calibrated posterior and spend oracle-free computation changing the next de novo proposal distribution without allowing surrogate errors to accumulate permanently in the true-reward policy.

applicability_conditions: Canonical corpus support is replicated across three independently prepared artifacts: every preparation reduces fixed held-out token NLL by at least 3.693098000427543 and unique-valid seeded support ranges from 0.78515625 to 0.814453125, with 1,213/1,536 draws novel to the selected corpus. Transfer is supported when the allowed corpus and tokenizer provide comparable syntax and novelty.

Exact task-local surrogate assimilation is supported from 10 through 300 observations in all 15 seed-task sessions: all 450 fits are positive definite with exactly-once coverage, all 435 feedback refits move both fixed-probe posterior moments, and all 4,500 leave-one-out influences are nonzero. This does not by itself support calibrated extrapolation outside the frozen representation's local chemical support.

True-reward anchoring is supported when every returned batch has reward variation: all 435 adaptive batches vary, move the anchor with finite nonzero pressure, leave the frozen prior unchanged, and use zero surrogate reward. Consistent higher-over-lower ordering is less supported on deco_hop and median_2, where the three-seed pooled preferential-gain means are negative.

Disposable surrogate-reward policy optimization is supported as a reproducible aggregate distribution shift: every one of 435 clones moves while its anchor remains unchanged, all three seed-level mean paired lifts are positive, and 305/435 rounds improve. Transfer is weakest for objectives and representations resembling sitagliptin_mpo, whose pooled lift is near zero, and for seed-task states such as seed-2 zaleplon_mpo where the mean lift is negative.

Fresh de novo acquisition is supported when optimized clones retain enough validity and novelty: every one of 435 rounds constructs at least 80 eligible canonical molecules, emits exactly 10 fully traced fresh samples, and incurs no evaluator-level invalid or duplicate attempt. Lower-validity tokenizers or strongly collapsed clones may not preserve this margin.

Greedy expected improvement is supported as an exact ordering operation over finite fresh pools: all 4,350 selections are logged maxima and all fantasies reduce remaining variance without entering the oracle table. Its practical usefulness is least supported when expected-improvement lift collapses near the numerical floor.

Task isolation is supported by 15 fresh objective sessions, each initialized with ten observations and the seed-specific frozen-prior hash; no labeled observations, fitted surrogate, anchor state, pool, or clone is transferred between tasks. The behavioural result now covers all three Search Seeds under the frozen 300-call, batch-10 Hard-Five protocol.

possible_failure_causes: Surrogate-reward improvement is aggregate rather than round-universal: 130/435 paired rounds have negative lift. The sitagliptin_mpo pooled lift is only 0.00011006466612005493 with 42/87 positive rounds, and seed 2 zaleplon_mpo has mean lift -0.004372728986746883 with 14/29 positive rounds. A locally misleading small-data posterior or bounded inner-update interference can therefore shift a valid clone away from higher posterior mean in a particular round even though all three seed-level pooled means are positive.

True-reward anchor movement is also not monotonically score ordered. Higher-minus-lower-score likelihood gain is negative in 157/435 adaptive updates, with pooled task means -0.02718440034351815 on deco_hop and -0.006357638893285017 on median_2; corresponding true-score/gain covariance is negative in 136/435 updates. Frozen-prior regularization, sequence-length effects, shared parameters, and only three optimizer steps can oppose preferential movement for individual batches while still producing finite true-reward pressure.

Expected-improvement ordering is exact, but practical discrimination can nearly vanish after the improvement threshold becomes hard to exceed: the three-seed minimum selected-minus-pool-mean lift is 2.050285431385548e-178 and the pooled median is 1.2308389072432816e-12. Numerically nominal maximum-EI selection may then carry little useful acquisition pressure despite satisfying the mechanism receipt.

The three-seed aggregate eligible yield is 0.7088946324143692 and every pool fills, but 17,914 parse failures, 524 non-completions, 1,275 already-evaluated identities, and 2,557 within-pool collisions occur among the logged draws. Harder syntax, a narrower prior, or a more collapsed clone could exhaust the 3,000-draw safety bound even though the observed minimum pool remains 80.

All observations measurably affect a finite posterior, but these receipts establish assimilation rather than calibration or chemically useful generalization. Frozen sequence embeddings can still place reward-discontinuous or out-of-support chemistry poorly, especially when the relevant optimum requires sequences absent from the corpus-supported policy.

Preparation itself is stochastic: the three frozen priors have different artifact hashes and unique-valid support ranges from 0.78515625 to 0.814453125. The mechanism activates for all observed artifacts, but transfer is less secure if a future preparation lands on materially weaker validity, novelty, or representation quality.

The evidence now spans all three Search Seeds and the frozen Hard-Five tasks, but it does not isolate the separate score contribution of corpus pretraining, true-reward anchoring, surrogate-conditioned generation, and expected-improvement acquisition. Confirmation here is the pre-registered behavioural mechanism result, not a claim that each retained component independently improves terminal score.

applicability_conditions: Supported when the allowed unlabeled corpus provides learnable canonical-SMILES syntax: 245,904 training examples reduced held-out token NLL by 3.738503367948076, and the trained prior's seeded unique-valid fraction was 0.814453125 with 411/512 draws novel to the selected corpus split.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus contains enough canonical SMILES syntax and chemical diversity for the compact autoregressive prior to generate valid novel molecules within the preparation and per-task time limits.

Frozen corpus-trained sequence embeddings place structurally and reward-related molecules close enough that a probabilistic surrogate fit from ten initial and subsequent task-local observations has useful local posterior structure and nondegenerate uncertainty.

Returned scores have enough variation for true-reward augmented-likelihood updates to distinguish anchor training weights and for expected improvement to distinguish members of each fresh ephemeral pool.

Bounded prior-regularized surrogate-reward updates can shift token probabilities toward useful regions without collapsing validity or novelty, and the oracle anchor remains a recoverable starting point when a round's surrogate is misleading.
Ancestral sampling from the optimized clone yields enough valid, unseen canonical molecules to form an acquisition pool and fill every evaluator-announced batch before the 3000-proposal safety limit.

Useful high-scoring chemistry is reachable by autoregressive policy shifts supported by the corpus representation; transfer is weaker for discontinuous objectives, disconnected rewarding modes absent from the prior, severely miscalibrated small-data posteriors, or objectives whose best regions require sequences the tokenizer and decoder cannot express.
Each objective is handled by a fresh process with no labeled observations, fitted surrogate, anchor updates, ephemeral candidates, or inner-policy state transferred across tasks.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if the prepared canonical policy cannot generate valid novel molecules, if all real observations are not assimilated into a finite probabilistic posterior, if surrogate-only inner optimization fails to move a disposable clone toward higher posterior-mean reward while leaving the oracle anchor unchanged, if the persistent anchor receives surrogate rather than true-reward updates, or if submitted molecules cannot be traced to fresh ancestral clone samples selected in the logged greedy expected-improvement order.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode as corpus-only training of a compact autoregressive SMILES language model, retaining a frozen prior, vocabulary, canonical-sequence encoder weights, and held-out generation diagnostics as reusable artifacts. In run mode, seed every RNG from init, load the artifacts on logical cuda:0, use exactly one canonical SMILES view per scored molecule, and build a task-local exact probabilistic regressor on frozen pretrained sequence embeddings. Initialize a persistent oracle anchor from the prior and update it after each observe message with score-weighted augmented-likelihood training on only genuinely oracle-scored task-local molecules, regularized to the frozen prior. For every suggest message, make a fresh clone of that anchor, perform bounded oracle-free augmented-likelihood updates whose molecular rewards are the current surrogate posterior means, ancestrally sample complete SMILES only from the resulting clone, canonicalize and remove invalid, previously evaluated, previously emitted, and within-pool duplicate products, and keep the resulting finite pool only for that round. Select exactly the batch size announced in init by sequential greedy expected improvement against the best true score, conditioning each later selection with a posterior-mean fantasy to account for already selected candidates. Retain generation and acquisition provenance for observability, never score or retrieve corpus members as candidates, never use surrogate rewards to update the persistent anchor, and discard both the pool and inner clone after the round.
research_intent.mechanism: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive canonical-SMILES prior and frozen sequence representation only on the unlabeled corpus, then restart each objective with an oracle anchor copied from that prior and a probabilistic surrogate fit to every task-local scored molecule. Before each suggestion, clone the current oracle anchor, optimize only that disposable clone against the surrogate posterior mean under prior regularization, ancestrally generate a fresh ephemeral set from the changed token policy, and select the evaluator-announced batch by greedy expected improvement. After oracle feedback, refit the surrogate on all real observations, update the persistent oracle anchor only from returned true rewards, and discard the surrogate-trained clone, so surrogate feedback changes the source distribution before acquisition while every submitted molecule remains de novo.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: After the ten fixed observations, each objective permits only 290 adaptive oracle calls and therefore only 29 feedback rounds at the frozen batch size. Directly updating a SMILES policy from those sparse batches can overfit noisy winners, while merely ranking samples from an unchanged prior cannot move proposal mass toward promising chemistry. The root must turn every task-local observation, including low scores, into a calibrated posterior and spend oracle-free computation changing the next de novo proposal distribution without allowing surrogate errors to accumulate permanently in the true-reward policy.
